identification: Single live-edge timber slab, about 1.5-1.8 m x 35-40 cm, rough sawn, chalked 1273. Photo shows pale to mid brown timber with ring-porous grain, more like elm/ash/European walnut sapwood than dark black walnut; a check/split across the lower third and a knot/bark inclusion near the top. Sits against a neighbouring slab (1275).
